title: Water - Saturation Pressure and Specific Weight vs. Temperature
description: Vapor pressure and specific weight of water at temperatures ranging 32 to 212 °F - Imperial Units. This tool provides saturation pressure (feet water column) and specific weight (pound per cubic foot) of water based on temperature.
